description: Run a Snowflake Cortex LLM function on a table and write results to a new table.

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.
description.label: Description

owners.description: Asset owners — team names ('team:analytics') or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds for the catalog (e.g. ['snowflake', 'python']). Auto-inferred from component name when unset.
kinds.label: Kinds

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before the asset is considered stale. Builds a FreshnessPolicy when set.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag Minutes

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule string for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron

column_lineage.label: Column Lineage
column_lineage.description: Column-level lineage, emitted as `dagster/column_lineage` metadata on every materialization: {output column: [upstream columns]}, e.g. {'revenue': ['price', 'quantity']}. The upstream asset is `upstream_asset_key`, or the only entry of `deps`; with several upstream assets, name each column '<asset_key>:<column>'. Ignored with a warning when no upstream asset can be resolved.

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', or None for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format (e.g. '2024-01-01'). Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter the upstream DataFrame to the current date partition key.
partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme,globex,initech'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_static_dim.description: Dimension name for the static axis in multi-partitioning, e.g. 'customer'.
partition_static_dim.label: Partition Static Dim

partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter the upstream DataFrame to the current static partition value.
partition_static_column.label: Partition Static Column

snowflake_account_env_var.label: Snowflake Account Env Var
snowflake_account_env_var.description: Env var name holding the Snowflake account identifier.

snowflake_user_env_var.label: Snowflake User Env Var
snowflake_user_env_var.description: Env var name holding the Snowflake username.

snowflake_password_env_var.label: Snowflake Password Env Var
snowflake_password_env_var.description: Env var name holding the Snowflake password. Leave None / empty when using SSO or keypair.

snowflake_private_key_file_env_var.label: Snowflake Private Key File Env Var
snowflake_private_key_file_env_var.description: Env var holding the path to a PEM RSA private key file (for snowflake_authenticator='SNOWFLAKE_JWT').

snowflake_private_key_file_pwd_env_var.label: Snowflake Private Key File Pwd Env Var
snowflake_private_key_file_pwd_env_var.description: Env var holding the passphrase for an encrypted private key file (optional).

snowflake_token_env_var.label: Snowflake Token Env Var
snowflake_token_env_var.description: Env var holding an OAuth / PAT token (with snowflake_authenticator='oauth' or PAT).

snowflake_warehouse.label: Snowflake Warehouse
snowflake_warehouse.description: Snowflake virtual warehouse to use. Uses the user default if None.

source_table.label: Source Table
source_table.description: Source table name (fully qualified or relative to database/schema).

target_table.label: Target Table
target_table.description: Target table where enriched results are written.

cortex_function.label: Cortex Function
cortex_function.description: Cortex function to apply: COMPLETE, CLASSIFY_TEXT, SENTIMENT, SUMMARIZE, TRANSLATE, or EXTRACT_ANSWER.

prompt_template.label: Prompt Template
prompt_template.description: For COMPLETE: prompt template with a {text} placeholder. E.g. 'Summarize this in one sentence: {text}'

translate_target_language.label: Translate Target Language
translate_target_language.description: For TRANSLATE: BCP-47 language code, e.g. "en", "fr", "de".

extract_answer_question.label: Extract Answer Question
extract_answer_question.description: For EXTRACT_ANSWER: the question to answer from the text.

if_exists.label: If Exists
if_exists.description: Table write mode: "replace" (CREATE OR REPLACE) or "append" (INSERT INTO).

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Row batch size for logging progress (does not affect SQL execution).

name: Snowflake Cortex Asset
